steps.name: The other side discovered in the sanctuary

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Is it already time? Seeing that the air at the entrance to the valley has changed, it seems to be %s.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina, I have never delivered a message without knowing its content, but this time I am a bit curious.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm curious too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Although I have never been to Freios, I know it to be a continent where the breath of the gods remains.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: An empire of great power on such a continent, and an emperor with the power of prophecy. It's probably someone special.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, the edict you handed over to %s. The traces of power left there are the proof... . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina felt it too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Prophecy is speaking through the mouth of God. So maybe the power the emperor has is... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Maybe it's like us or 'them'.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adkina, that’s… .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Mir, you probably know this to some extent.
(Adkina stops talking when he sees %s in the distance. Mir also nods as if he understands.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I was waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Adkina, I'm not late, right?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Don't worry. Because there is still room.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there was Mir too.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. I also arrived quickly. Adventurer I'm going to check the contents inside as it's my job.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mir is always enthusiastic.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Thank you for the compliment. Ah, I think it's time. Then open the edict.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then where… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: “Dear messenger of the goddess. A wicked group is in Sanctuary Eidos. They are trying to sabotage the oracle. 」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If they… .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Huh, what happened to Eidos? Not much happened a while ago. Could you please read the rest first?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text:
“Please visit for the sake of your god. 

Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire - Kaina Dawn Sylvaria… .」

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: For Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought I would go there someday for Iris. But is it okay to just go? .

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Not long ago, I delivered Gaia's words to the Ceres Church. The oracle will be fulfilled where the form behind it can be discovered... .

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That means that an oracle is given to a place called Eidos.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Huh, now that I think about it, there are really only a few days left. If it's Eidos, the paladins will definitely know about the oracle, and they'll try to receive the oracle from each other.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Paladins who have received an oracle become something that no one can touch.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, how did you receive the royal decree from His Majesty the Sylvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: I went to the Temple of Ceres in a delivery truck and received it from a sister who gave it to me.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: He said it was His Majesty's order and told me to convey it to Adventurer. I think he knew I was going to the Temple of Ceres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth is going on when the other side appears and there are beings who interfere with the oracle? .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go to Sanctuary Eidos. Adkina, Mir. thank you.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: … I'd like to hope it's not a big deal, but it's definitely not normal. Please be careful.

lines.speaker: 미르
lines.text: Adventurer, be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will come back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, shall we go to the sanctuary?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I don't know the way to go. How should I get there? Oh, there was a postscript in the edict. Let’s see… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please tell those who want to run amok to run amok... ? What is this about... .

lines.speaker: 누군가의 목소리
lines.text: [Adventurer… .]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The voice of the minuet is correct.
(The voice of the minuet is no longer heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't do it. Let's go first... .

steps.name: Where is Gaia...
steps.objective: Go to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Center Esnil”.

lines.text: (Minuet is standing with a blank expression. It looks the same as usual, but something feels different.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, what do you mean? I can't hear anything... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Stand. two. le. count. yo. this… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you in a hurry?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: A. this. ah. sir. second. do. and. main. count. yo. this.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: That. go. me. get on. It happened. uh. yo. this… .
(Minuet struggles to open her mouth and try to convey something, but still no voice comes out.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, what does that mean? No, somehow I will find Gaia... .
(Minuet grabs %s's hands. Then the movement stops, as if life has disappeared.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet? Hey, minuet?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The body of the minuet becomes blurred... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I felt that way when I first came to Adrica.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm dizzy... It feels like the illusory earth is swallowing my memories...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Follow Iris… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Wake up, %s… .
(Medea comes into %s's field of vision. Medea taps %s's shoulder with the staff she was holding.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medea? Oh, that's right! Minuet! The minuet... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Calm down. You may become confused again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… … .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Adrika, whom you saved, is in this state again... . It's my fault for not paying attention.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: %s, I will be here so don't worry too much. Go ahead and go where you want to go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Medea… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I know what you're going to say. but… .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: I will help God with this now. Then you, who are helping God, will be helping you.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: To repay the trust you have shown me so far... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There are a lot of things I want to ask, but the situation is the way it is right now, so let’s do it later….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I know what you mean. Then please take care of the minuet.

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The other side of appearing in the Sanctuary... Let's go to Mr. Dana and talk to him. He's sure to know something.)
(Medea confirms that %s's energy has disappeared from Adrica and lays down the minuet.)

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Goddess... .

lines.speaker: 메디아
lines.text: Why did you let me feel this... .

steps.name: the border behind
steps.objective: Check what happened to [Dana] and visit [Sera] at the ‘Guild Inn’.

lines.text: (Dana seems to be thinking about something with her eyes closed. Then, as if she felt something, she hurriedly swings the stick in her hand as if stabbing her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh!! Mr. Dana!! It's me, %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Could you please take that cane away? I almost got stabbed.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, sorry. I thought it was someone else.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Someone else?
(Dana withdraws her wand and smiles lightly. However, that expression quickly collapses as her legs suddenly loosen.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you for supporting me. You'll be fine if you get some rest. I hope it’s a little longer this time, but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where does it hurt?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I do this sometimes. It's just uncomfortable rather than painful. Sometimes my legs feel loose after I exert a lot of effort.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Still, I'm glad I have this wand that Shiina made. Otherwise, you won't be able to stand properly.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I need to stay alive. That way, I can punish my sister and continue to care for Shiina.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Why do I keep telling stories that I don't have to do as long as %s comes?
(Dana’s expression looks complicated.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sorry, the story is long.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry too. I thought he came to visit me while I was on break.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm fine. I think I know why %s is here, but we have to go to Sanctuary, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard that a dark side has been discovered in Sanctuary Eidos.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That's right. Raclette and Zelic were looking into it, but they had no choice but to stop their investigation. The higher-ups in Sanctuary hate people like us so much.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It would be an uproar if ungodly people came to a sacred place where oracles are given. They really think of us as they want, regardless of whether they are saints or monks.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, that's probably why my sister called %s. Or maybe it was led by another being... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I spoke to the paladins at the tavern. If you go to Sera, she will tell you how to get to Sanctuary Eidos.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Dana.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: And... . So… .
(Dana is saying something, but no sound is heard.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mr. Dana? What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm saying something, but I can't hear anything...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what is this?!
(Suddenly, a large black shadow rises like a wave behind %s's back. Then, it grabs %s's body and swallows it up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .
Princess. It's been a while. The harsh greetings are still the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .
(Dana slowly appears along with the owner of the unfamiliar voice in the darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Here… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: You, you… Obviously… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Mr. Dana? And who is that? No, I was just in front of Dana… am I invisible?)
(Dayna swings her staff at the person she called a demon with deadly intent.)
Do you mind if this barrier that blocks me from others is broken? If you don’t mind… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me about your business.
(Dana withdraws her staff and looks at the demon.)
Hehe, I never thought the barrier created by mere human ability could be this big... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I don't want to be praised by demons. So tell me… .
I regretted what happened back then. Because it had to be that way.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The demon who sacrificed my younger brother and made me like this... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The Prince of Despair, Barbatos... .
(Dana is indignant that only then did she remember the name of the demon race.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Oh, you remember. It's an honor for you to call my name, Princess. I was involved in it, but only a small part. At the center of it all is ‘her’… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Her?)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe, I'm just here to say hello, so I'll be leaving soon. Back then, the princess and her sisters had business to do, but not now.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Don't I have business to attend to? Then, surely to %s… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It belongs to the person who does the work rather than the errand boy. I just tell him what to do.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Are you telling me? how… .
(Barbatos' eyes become sharper and he cuts the air around him with a huge sword he pulls out from somewhere.)
(The effect must have reached Dana, who sits down with a painful expression on her face.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: The princess should not collapse like this. Because I plan to invite you to a world where I will become the master. And you must become a vessel for the collapsed world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If you are someone who walks in the shadow between light and darkness, you are worthy of it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: The other side discovered in Eidos is... . also… .
(Dana loses consciousness without even finishing speaking. Barbatos then kneels and kisses the tips of Dana's fallen fingers.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You did well with your human spirit, princess. No matter how great the power, humans are just humans, weak beings... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will now become the master of all humans, including the princess. I promise.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then I will leave to prepare for the stage. Oh, that's right.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'm sorry. I forgot for a moment. Adventurer, loved by God. The princess just lost her mind, so don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you? What is it here?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I can't help it. Let me answer.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will cut down all the gods who love you. Not only Gaia, but that girl too. Did you say Iris?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? If you touch Iris, I won't let you go!

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Haha, a half-decent rookie girl won't notice this moment anyway. How about doing this for now?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You don't have a choice anyway. Then I will take out the silver coins.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Front and back, front and back. It's just a different answer depending on the situation... . When the back comes out, I will do exactly what I want... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: If it comes up, I'll give you a chance.  The side with the devil's horns on it is the front.
(Barvatos throws a silver coin from his pocket towards one. After a while, the silver coin flows into his palm and waits for the moment to be confirmed.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Where should I look?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Front… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You're lucky. Then, a few more chances... . To be precise, I will give you an ordeal. Overcoming this ordeal is the only way to save your god.
(Barvatos lifts the fallen Dana up so that she can lean against the wall. He then turns his head and sneers at %s.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Then let's see if we can put an end to that ordeal.
(As soon as Barbatos finishes speaking, the ominous darkness comes again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait… .
(Darkness swallows Adventurer so that it cannot struggle, and flows somewhere through the gaping gap.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Mr. %s, wake up!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Suddenly, you lost your mind.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… . I didn't lose my mind... . How should I explain it... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yeah, so that's... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Explain to Dana everything you just saw.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Barbatos... , That demon appeared? … Damn… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I feel bad… . Why did you show up?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, Dana. Now, what is the difference between me and Dana recognizing Barbatos and not recognizing him?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Twisted space and time... , I'm using that. I still wonder about that. A being called a demon has that kind of ability... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It was definitely like that back then... . perhaps… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, no. Mr. %s. Are you going straight to the sanctuary? Are you in any pain right now?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, it's okay. I'm going right away.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: If Barbatos showed up, it wouldn't be normal. Especially if that demon is interfering with the oracle.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does Barbatos want from Dana…?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I want to go with you, but I'm sorry I can't go with you.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: So… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.  Don't worry too much. I'll go see Sarah.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What Barbatos hopes for in Sanctuary may be... .
(The guild inn, which is always full of people, feels quieter than usual. At the sound of the door opening, Sarah approaches and smiles brightly.)

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How have you been?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I'm always the same. These are my days helping out at the inn and training.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How is Platinum?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: It's hard to see my senior because he's busy these days. If you work that much, you could easily become a Saber in the Holy Order... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Come to think of it, the only paladins I saw in Sanctuary were Sera, Platinum, and Aurum.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: You will be able to meet Aurum soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: That happened quite a bit. Ahaha… .

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: I'd like to tell you to take a break and go, but I have to tell you.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: At the request of His Majesty, the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire, the Sanctuary Elders have granted permission for Adventurer to enter the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Originally, it was a place where outsiders were rarely allowed to enter, but it could be said to be a special case.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Then where should I go?

lines.speaker: 세라
lines.text: Would you like to close your eyes for a moment?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? then… .

steps.name: Understanding the situation (1)
steps.objective: Defeat [Future Gremory] and [Saint Valkyrie Ranger] in “Sanctuary Eidos” and report to [Aurum] at “Sanctuary Eidos Gate”.

lines.text: (When I open my eyes, I feel an unfamiliar yet strange atmosphere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This place… ?
(A woman holding a wooden bat slowly approaches the center of an office-like space that serves as a gateway to somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Someone said it was Adventurer. If it had been an enemy, I would have blown it up... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks very disappointing.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I was waiting. Welcome to Sanctuary Eidos. First, would you please sign this entry record? Name %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. Wait, this is Sanctuary Eidos? And you were waiting for me?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The place where the oracle is received, Gaia-sama, and Barbatos targeting Gaia-sama...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We need to find where Barbatos is.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer? What are you thinking like that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is there anyone here but Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Something happened here, so we all went out to take care of it. I feel like I want to go out too, but I have been ordered to greet Adventurer here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I don't know the details, but demons and demons have appeared in the sanctuary. And even holy beings seem to be running wild under their influence.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I believe they were trying to figure out Adventurer's whereabouts because they couldn't even approach the sanctuary of the covenant.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shouldn’t Aurum go out too? He is the most skilled saber.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's a shame, but I was placed on probation... . So I'm stuck here.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I was wandering around Eastland with the desire to learn more, but I was caught by Jiscard, and His Majesty told me not to go wild for a while... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ah, should I say that it is also Aurum-like...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: When you say you received an order, it means that His Majesty said so.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: … Yes, His Majesty has not yet given the order to go on a rampage... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: His Majesty's edict says that anyone who wants to go on a rampage should go on a rampage, so I think it's okay to go on a rampage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Show Emperor Kaina's edict to Aurum.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Thank you, Your Majesty. Then, I will do my best to show my enemies that it is as spicy as the freeling curry I found in Eastland.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First of all, I don't know how many enemies there are, so I need to check... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Great! This is what I was waiting for. Oh, I have to scold not only the enemies but also the rampaging beings, do you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it were Aurum's weapon and me, I think the beings in Sanctuary would return to their original state.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then shall we go?
(Two people go out to check on the situation in Sanctuary Eidos. After a while, a knight wearing silver armor and huge gauntlets appears at the gate of the unoccupied sanctuary.)
… Is it here?
But why is there no one??

steps.name: Understanding the situation (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Ghost Warrior of Nothingness] and [Saint Steed] in “Sanctuary Eidos” and report to [Argent] in “Sanctuary Eidos”.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: The beings you just saw are the sacred souls of the Valkyries who fought for the gods in ancient times. The body has died, but only the spirit remains and remains here.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: They joined the knights in the sanctuary as they searched for the hidden piece.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … But you came here to scold those Valkyries.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's okay. As the situation is the same, the Valkyries will understand.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: But, if you can't recognize me as Saber, there's definitely something there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We'll have to fight them until we find the cause.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (We have to hurry….)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I'll help you too! Ugh, you… .
(Aurum is surprised to see a red-haired knight wearing silver armor waiting inside.)
Although this is an imperial order, I hope that you will uphold your duties as a Holy Knight. Aurum.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes… .
(...Aurum makes a sullen expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're not Holy Orders or Saber.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He is said to be Argent of the knights belonging to the imperial family of the Sylvaria Empire. I am accompanying you by order of His Majesty.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Now that you're here, would you please sign this entry record, Argent?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, do you know what is happening here? I think you can see that you came according to His Majesty's orders... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Your Majesty has asked you to comply with the request of the Council. He said I could help him by meeting %s in the Sanctuary... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see… .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: The nobles in the council are really selfish... . Oh, no. Aurum, what is the situation in Sanctuary?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: That's it... .
(Aurum explains the situation in Sanctuary to Argent.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Where should I find the other side? Huh?!)
(Suddenly, an unexplained vibration occurs on the floor. Argent catches Aurum from falling.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Argent, I'm sorry. This must be… .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It doesn't seem like a typical earthquake. It looks like someone artificially caused it... . I'm glad it doesn't continue though... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This feeling….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I need to go right away. The innermost part of the sanctuary... . I felt it there. The feeling of vibration... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It feels like it’s calling me….)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay. Let's leave right away. Aurum, please take the lead.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes… . Then please follow along.

steps.name: angel through the door
steps.objective: After talking to [Argent] in “Sanctuary Eidos”, defeat [Michaela] in “Hile”. Then come back and report to [Argent].

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … The situation is more serious than I thought.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It feels like the ‘sky of chaos’ I saw in a book I once read.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … If the sky is chaotic... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hundreds of years ago, it was a war over the supremacy of Freios. In that war there was the rise and fall of many powers and kingdoms.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: At that time, the Kingdom of Sylvaria gained hegemony and was reborn as an empire. This is a story from the past, it's not important now.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This is a situation where demons and demons are trying hard to stop the oracle, and sacred beings, including Valkyrie, cannot distinguish between enemies.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: And it's probably related to the reason you came here.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I would like you to tell me. Although it is His Majesty's order, only then can I understand and help.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Now that I think about it, I’m curious too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aurum seemed so happy just dealing with his enemies that he didn't have time to say anything.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, please reflect.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes… . reflection… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The two seem to get along well. I wonder if they knew each other from the beginning….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes… . Argent, you also know Dana, right?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It tells everything that happened after receiving the edict from Argent and Aurum.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Is the princess okay?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You'll be fine. What Barbatos is currently focusing on is Sanctuary... . First you have to find him and take him down. A demon threatening God... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent seems to know Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: When I was the youngest member of the Order, he appeared. The princesses almost got into big trouble. Although some of the memories of that time have disappeared... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Disappeared memories….)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Something strange must be happening in the Sanctuary of the Covenant.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Let's go right now.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: However, Adventurer and Argent cannot enter now. I have to say hello to ‘him’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is that?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: A battle angel cherished by the ancient gods, a teacher of the Valkyries and a friend of the Paladins... . This is Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If you say hello to Michaela, you will be eligible to enter the sanctuary of the covenant.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: You can just go in, but there are times when you won't see what you want to see.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … okay. By the way, Aurum. What is the red thing behind it?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes? … What is that? I've been on probation so I haven't been able to come out... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this a door leading somewhere? There's a lot of feathers in there.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Huh, this is definitely Michaela’s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That means Michaela is in there.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … What would you like to do? What you see inside is clearly a sanctuary, but it doesn’t seem to be a sanctuary… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then this is the other side of the sanctuary… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, Aurum. Let's go in.
(The moment you are about to enter, you hear Barbatos' voice from above.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: […] It's not a big deal, but I'll give you a little test.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos?!
(Suddenly, a huge number of demons appear and surround the party. Moreover, the red light on the door gradually becomes darker.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: It's funny that the trials sent by the demons are like this. I'll take care of this first and then chase after you.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Ugh, there's something like a barrier here, so it's blocked. But why does Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it's because it's me, not the two of them, that Barbatos wants to test.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay. Aurum and I will deal with these guys. Adventurer,

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … sorry. Then I'll come back quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (They say that if you don't meet Michaela, you won't be able to meet Gaia even if you enter the sanctuary of the covenant...)
(%s's figure heads toward the red space that seems to have swallowed the sanctuary, and Argent, who has seen this, gently looks at Aurum.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, it’s okay for you to lay down your duties for a moment.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Really? To hear something like this from Argent... . This is so... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Then shall we go on a rampage?
(A world filled with a mixture of red light and gloomy energy. The moment you step into it, you feel an inexplicable discomfort.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This must be a sanctuary... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: […] This is a sanctuary, but it is not a sanctuary. A tomb-like place where the past of the gods is sealed... . Hille… .]
(Once again, Barbatos' voice penetrates the red space and reaches %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... . What on earth do you want?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: […] Did you forget? This is my ordeal for you... . I wonder how far I can struggle. And I’m looking forward to it.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Anyway, decent packaging... , I know you’re going to do whatever you want anyway.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: […] Hehe, no matter what you think, nothing will change.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is this something to do with Vice?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: […] That's an interesting question.]

lines.speaker: 바르바토스의 목소리
lines.text: [Then I will answer you. The purpose is different, but the essence is the same... .]
(The voice contains displeasure towards someone. Then, the voice of the demon who said he would give him a trial disappears without a trace.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … As soon as I told him about Vice, he just disappeared. You seem upset... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: First, we have to find Michaela. Because only then can you meet Gaia... . Okay, let's go.
(It is the end of a world filled with red light, a space where there is nowhere to advance or retreat. In front of it, a woman dressed in a sacred knight's uniform with pure white wings is flying.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela… , right?
(A woman with wings nods at the voice calling her. Then she flies at high speed and swings her sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, don't attack.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Whoa, I barely managed to dodge it. It’s a fast and sharp attack….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I came to see Michaela... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: … Mika knows.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I came into this space to confirm, but it wasn't my intention that this happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I need to check on Mika.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: I can feel Gaia's touch, Ceres' heart, and Iris's worry all from you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If that's all you feel, there's no need to attack me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The smell of an ominous presence brought me here. brutish… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Smell… ?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Yeah, the smell. Mika can't have someone with that scent in the Sanctuary.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now, wait a minute. I am not an enemy you have to fight with, Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Because Mika knows that you belong to the goddess. Because I believe it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think there is a misunderstanding, please think again.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It's not a misunderstanding.
(Michaela, holding a sword, flaps her wings and flies towards %s at high speed.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Good defense... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I managed to stop it, but it's hard to hold on like this...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Please cut me off from this situation, which is Mika's will but not my will. The only ones who can make me like this are those with great power... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? Now, wait… . Are you moving as you please? Isn't it of your own will?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Please hang up. Even for Gaia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I want you to stop... . What the hell… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Please.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: … Otherwise you will die.
(Michaela’s eyes look sad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't want to fight... . ah!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Perhaps with my power... I might be able to turn Michaela back to normal.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, hold on until Michaela comes to her senses. So don’t break down!!
(%s's attack with all his might reaches Michaela.)
(Mikaela seems to have lost strength in her legs and sits down, holding the sword.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Mika… Ella?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is okay. Thanks to you, the thing that was binding Mika was broken... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The only thing that can control Mika is someone higher than Mika... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? So, are you saying that there is someone who intentionally made Michaela like this?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, … be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?
(Michaela steps in front of %s and deflects an attack from someone attacking her.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Devil… ?
(Someone who failed the raid steps back.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Are you… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It looks like this ordeal ended sooner than I expected. Then, let’s get rid of the annoying things for a while.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you talking about?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Ugh… . … Why me... .
(Suddenly Michaela loses consciousness and falls down.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Michaela? Hey Michaela!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth did you do to Michaela?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Actually, I don't know either. I just thought it would be nice to be quiet. My interest is not in that angel… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, if you want to save the angel your gods cherished, please take him out right away. otherwise… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: They will all be consumed by the ominous energy of this space.
(Barvatos turns his back, looking at %s with a sneer.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, it is impossible for you to attack me in this space without the help of a battle angel. While you're thinking nonsense, take a quick step out of the way.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Before other demons come after... . I will go. Let’s wait for the next stage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What's going on in the demon world? You know Vice. Everything Weiss did was connected to the energy of the demon world.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Didn't I tell you? The purpose is different, but the essence is the same.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now, do you want to continue like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Michaela’s condition is not good.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Well then... . Next, please follow the angel’s will.
(A black butterfly appears from nowhere, circles around Barbatos, and then disappears together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think I definitely hit the nail on the head.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … But that doesn't mean he's an easy opponent. Ugh.
(He lifts Michaela up and supports her, but there is still no sign of her waking up.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, just hang on a little longer. I think I can go out somehow... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: As expected, I don’t know His Majesty’s intentions… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, it's outside. It's finally here,
(Argent approaches in surprise at the voice of %s coming from behind him.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, are you okay?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I'm fine... . Michaela… .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: This is Michaela, the battle angel... .  It's beautiful.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, what happened in that red space?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Argent what happened.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … It was like that.
(Argent looks at Michaela and cannot continue speaking.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But where is Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum is resting at the gateway after defeating other knights and the demons and demons roaming the sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I was waiting here for %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sorry. I wanted to get out quickly, but it was a little late. How much time has passed now?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Four days have passed.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Four days?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: We wanted to go in too, but it was still blocked. A space where only authorized people can enter... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's the same as back then... A lot of time had passed when I left the main building of the magic academy.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: What were you thinking?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, the next stage that Barbatos is talking about… , I think it's probably there.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I went to the covenant sanctuary just in case, but there were no major problems. But, as Aurum said, to see it right... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I need to wake this person up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think you'll be able to know what's going on if you don't greet them properly. Since Aurum is at the gate, I'll have to go and find out how.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I will support Michaela. You must be tired from the battle... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Ah… .
(Argent tries to reach out and support Michaela, but cannot reach. It passes by like an illusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, but why am I… .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s is God's Adventurer. So I was able to take him out.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I will go and support Michaela. Argent, just in case, I'll ask you to escort me to the gate.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Let's go.

steps.name: To the sanctuary of the covenant...

lines.text: (As soon as you return to the gate, which is like the entrance to the sanctuary, Aurum runs up in surprise.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s, are you okay? Now, wait a minute. How did Michaela get here…? .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, hush. quietly… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes. First of all, Michaela is here... .
(As Michaela is laid down on the bed, an unknown light appears from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess I'll have to explain this to Aurum too. Here's how it happened... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Aurum about what happened in the red space.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: … This can't be... . Then how do we wake up Michaela?! Without Michaela, Sanctuary would be... . town… . town?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum, it's noisy. Mika is okay... .
(Michaela stands up with a tired expression on her face and reaches out to cover Aurum's mouth.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika is okay. No, it's not okay. It's a strange feeling.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika has never been like this before, but those demons… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s, thank you for your help. But, it's not over.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please allow me to enter the sanctuary of the covenant. I need to meet Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Ah, Gaia… . We must protect Gaia. However, now Mika cannot meet Gaia.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Order Mika to rest for a while... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s… . Say hello to Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Greetings.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How should I greet you?
(Mikaela approaches %s's face and kisses her cheek.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Greetings from Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wow, I was surprised.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Why?
(Mikaela looks like she has no idea.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: In some areas, people greet each other with that behavior... .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Yes, that is Michaela’s greeting.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: … Humans are strange.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, can you enter the sanctuary now?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Now %s… , you will be able to enter the sanctuary of the covenant. But, you have to be careful. He's waiting.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Fool… Toss.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is Barbatos.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The name is difficult. Babotos… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: He is no ordinary demon. %s, a being more dangerous than those you have faced so far... .
(Suddenly, an unexplained vibration occurs on the floor.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... ?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's the same as back then. Obviously… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: The demons and demons led by Babotos have reappeared. The power he has... , I need to check. However, Mika must rest now according to Gaia's wishes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela, please speak up.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Go see him as he wants.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Because I have to meet Gaia... .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika will ask you a favor. And I'm sorry... .
(After finishing speaking, Michaela loses consciousness and falls down on the bed.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Michaela… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hey, I'll go straight to the Sanctuary of the Covenant. so… .

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Don't worry. I will be watching over Michaela.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum, I feel like you might want to go on a rampage. Is that okay?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: It's okay. It's not often you get a chance to watch Michaela.
(Contrary to what he said, Aurum's expression looks very sad.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I will quickly resolve the matter with Barbatos and return. Please hold on until then... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, please come with me. I will escort you to the front of the sanctuary.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer, please be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll be back.

steps.name: some coins
steps.objective: Defeat [Barvatos] in the “Sanctuary of the Covenant” to obtain the <Grand Duke's Silver Coin>. Then report to [Argent] in “Sanctuary Eidos”.

lines.text: (Argent examines the condition of the demon fallen at his feet.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: They are definitely stronger than the guys who came here a few days ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That being said, I think Argent kills enemies too easily...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, there is still a passage to that red space. The atmosphere changed a lot after I came out with Michaela.
(The door to the Red Place, the other side of the Sanctuary, Hile that Barbatos spoke of is still open.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can feel all kinds of energy in the sanctuary of the covenant right now. This is….)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Would you mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, you have something to say.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's not important, we'll come back and talk about it.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Yes, please do so. Huh, there are enemies again... . Adventurer! Hurry up!
(As soon as he finishes speaking, Argent begins to defeat the enemies who appear in front of him.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Argent. Be careful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I don't know what else will happen, but let's hurry. We have to go and end this moment.)
(An altar in a space filled with sacred and bright light. Barbatos emerges from the darkness and slowly examines the altar.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It feels really strange that I call this contradictory place a stage.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ah, the hero you created has finally arrived on stage. Goddess Gaia.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You, who are trying hard not to fall asleep even at this moment, are the same now as they were then.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: … Are you here? %s… .
(Barvatos looks happy at the appearance of %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh, were you waiting? Let’s react calmly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The inside of the sanctuary was more complicated than I thought.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It seems like Michaela has guided you to meet the Goddess. First of all, I have something to talk about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How much do you know? How far have you reached the truth of this world?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: This world was born with the fate of destruction and constant extinction. It's pretty much what you know to be a threat.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Agashura, the being thought to be the culprit of all evil, the snake that misunderstood the will of creation, Lux, the lord of the demon world, and even Deimos, who would bring fear.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And a weak girl who changed from a human to a god.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You can believe whatever you want to believe. Still, the fate of this world does not change.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: All worlds with weak gods disappeared, accepting their fate of destruction.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Now that I think about it, it seems like some sinner is trying to use this world to save his world from destruction... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Oh, this isn't my story, so I'll stop. So let me tell you my purpose.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Any god who creates the world must have that much power. Only then can you be in awe.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: But what about this world? There is no god worthy of that. So that would be me.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: First, I will free the two goddesses you know from their fate tied to this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You are mistaken.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe, it's just that each person's perspective is different.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The god of this world I know may be as weak as you said. Still, I saved everyone from a big crisis. And I will continue to rescue you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Aren't you afraid? There is a being above you like this... . That being even controlled the angels of God.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'd be lying if I said I wasn't scared. Still, I came this far for Iris.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I like those eyes. %s… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I think I understand why the convict Vice wanted you as the key.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Key? Now, wait a minute... W-what is it? Barbatos' mood has changed...)
(As Barbatos adjusts his glasses and smiles, the air around him changes. The sacred atmosphere of the sanctuary is gradually erased.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Anyway, I… .
(Barvatos inserts his hand into a gap that seems to distort space and time. After a moment, the weapon in his hand is pointed at %s's face.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'll shatter your faith... .
(Barvatos' attack comes with a huge impact, breaking %s's posture.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...I thought it would be similar to Lethe... but it's different from the enemies I've faced so far...)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Phew, you are persistent. Do you still have the strength to hold on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's not over yet, Barbatos... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cough… . ha… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I was impressed. I saw you too easily.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I guess I still have the strength to speak. At this level, it would be appropriate for faith to be shattered... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: You are truly the most unpleasant being I have ever met. A heterogeneous person like me… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … A foreign entity? What does that mean?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: An entity that was not wanted, but was created according to someone's will.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Instead, I'll tell you something in return for filling the stage.
(As Barbatos withdraws his weapon and steps back, a strange energy flows towards %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't move... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Please do not mistake this for being a sinner's bondage. I hope you just listen to it like this, just like this.
(Barbatos' eyes turn lonely.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Somewhere in the twilight, I was there too. Their ugliness was superior to the life they created.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: What came to this world was a huge nightmare. Those who felt that power chose flight rather than resistance. They were gods.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: There had to be at least the strength of those fugitives to have any hope. So those who resisted tried to catch those who were running away.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: However, the fugitives extinguished or banished those who stood in their way to other places. So that I can never return to the world I love... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It wasn’t just a demon….)
(Barvatos adjusts his glasses and chuckles.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: That's the memory I remember. As for the rest, as you know, the young god stayed and fought, but it ended in a miserable end... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So the best I can do is... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: When my memories returned, the only remaining gods were a few in hiding.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I wanted revenge, but all the targets for revenge disappeared... . So this is what happened... . If it's a world doomed to destruction no matter who takes over... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: A world where only weak gods remain... . So they take their place… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ugh… Ugh… .
(Suddenly Barbatos falls down with a painful expression.)

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Don't touch him.]

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia… ? Where are you? Are you okay?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehehe, Goddess Gaia. Are you awake now? There's no way your power can reach you now... .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ugh… . The time has already come to this.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ahaha, I'm so lost in sentimentality that I can't keep track of time... .

lines.speaker: 가이아의 목소리
lines.text: [Please step aside, or you will… .]

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I will do that. I'll leave for today. However, we will continue to watch. Goddess Gaia and %s both… .

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: How will the will that led you change? .
(A black butterfly appears from nowhere, circles around Barbatos, and then disappears together.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos is gone... . Gaia, are you okay? All the ominous energy in the sanctuary has disappeared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is... ? silver… . Is it Barbatos's?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I think it said it had devil horns drawn on it. This is a butterfly... ? Plus, both the front and back are the same.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was fooled. However, I don’t think what Barbatos said was a lie… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, can you hear me? Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I can definitely feel it, but how can we meet? Let's go out first. I'll have to go out and check... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Same as back then. The demons and demons disappeared with the appearance of the black butterfly... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Has Barbatos stepped down? also… .
(Argent turns his head and looks in the direction of the covenant sanctuary.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Have you been there?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, are you hurt anywhere?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm fine. Are you okay with Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. and… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Argent what happened inside.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You haven't met Gaia. Then maybe there is a way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What method?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: There was a message from His Majesty. He said to use the symbol of the disruptor... .
(Argent reads %s's mood and stops talking.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: %s, I know how you feel.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Argent knows how I feel.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I will let you know later when I have the chance.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Sylvaria Empire really has a lot of secrets. I understand there were things I couldn't know, but why is there so much I can't talk about?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What kind of person is your Majesty?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: You are the monarch of the Sylvaria Empire. Respected and gracious… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not saying that.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: … I know what you’re going to say. But I don't have anything else to say. I just… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I understand, Argent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm not angry at Argent.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Sorry. When the time comes, I will take you to see Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Someday, I will meet you and ask you. Who on earth are you... Emperor Kaina?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Argent, please continue what you were saying earlier.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: He told me to hold it in my hand with my eyes closed and let it touch my chest. Then you can get to where you want... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The symbol of the disruptor is this silver coin left by Barbatos, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this butterfly shape?
(At that moment, the silver coin of Barbatos in %s's hand sparkles in the light.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh, I suddenly feel a divine energy...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where then… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Close your eyes and hold the silver coin to your chest...)
(Argent steps back and watches %s do as he said.)
(In an instant, an incredible sight unfolds in Argent’s field of vision.)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: What, what is it? These butterflies... ?
(A few butterflies with a mysterious light fly in from somewhere and pass by %s. Then, %s's appearance disappears along with the butterflies without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, open your eyes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Is this the sanctuary of the covenant? No, it’s different. It feels like a sanctuary but not a sanctuary… Is this also the other side? No. It’s definitely my first time here…)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Have I ever been here? Is this where I went to meet Barbatos?)
(It appears to be the sanctuary of the covenant, but it is a place with a different feel. Gaia is seen welcoming those who have been waiting with a warm smile.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank goodness. Because the person I can meet at this time is you... . And I didn't get hurt too much... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This time? What is that... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, isn't this it? Gaia, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm fine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, there are many things I want to ask you. However, I'm sure Gaia has a lot more to say, so I'll wait.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you, %s… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please close your eyes. %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .
(Gaia smiles and extends her hand toward %s.)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: My name is Gaia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What does this feel like?)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A little butterfly that opened its eyes and reached a place in search of light, created the earth there, and brought the seeds of life and song into it.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: My world.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: A world loved by beings like me.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Gaia, the earth god, please come closer.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please protect Adventurer who is here with me, the one who carries the will of Ceres and protects the child of destiny. God bless… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Same as when I met Ceres...)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Now open your eyes.
(Gaia makes eye contact with a bright smile.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I feel lighter, but I don't think anything has changed much...)

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I wanted to give a blessing to those who work hard for this world during my waking hours.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: The person who can come here according to the time of the moon and stars left behind by Ceres is the right person... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I didn’t know who it would be this time, but %s… . I'm glad Iris's favorite person came.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Gaia, for saving me and blessing me.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: No. I am more grateful. Now it's %s's turn. Please tell me what you want to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Tell us about Barbatos. Why did he try to touch Gaia?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: According to the providence of the universe, I wanted to give a blessing to the person who came here at that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It means that Barbatos could have come here.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (It's a terrible thing to even think about...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Gaia, did you know him too?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I forgot it because it wasn't that name. Like Lethe, he, too, was sent elsewhere by those who feared him. The place he fell into is the Demon World... .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: There, he seems to have become a demon, forgetting his name and memories.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. There is no information about the time I was asleep... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, Gaia. Oh, and… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: … There's something else I'd like to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know about the Emperor of the Sylvaria Empire?

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I'm sorry. I don't know anything about that either. The story while I was asleep... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Still, there is something I can tell you. Now you can meet your favorite Iris... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh, Iris… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: With your faith, Iris will now take care of you and life on earth in the capacity of a star god.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: However, in the future, there will be more and more groups threatening that child's power. So please stay by my side.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: I trust you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Please be patient to see Iris. After a short wait, Iris will call you directly and talk to you... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, Gaia. and… .

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: %s, I'll tell you more next time we meet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I still have more to say, but I will.

lines.speaker: 가이아
lines.text: Thank you. Then please be careful and return home.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How does it work? ah… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Gaia's image becomes blurred... What I see before my eyes...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Butterfly...?)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: (Suddenly the wind blows….)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: He's coming back.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Where is Adventurer from?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika feels… . Right in front... .
(With Michaela's words, a warm wind blows from somewhere. The moment a butterfly with a mysterious light follows the wind and touches it, Adventurer is slowly revealed.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Adventurer. You're here!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Aurum's voice? Oh, have we arrived?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The light is dazzling... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … I'm dizzy... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm losing my mind...)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Good job, %s. Let’s rest for a while by Mika’s side.
(Mikaela approaches %s, who is about to collapse unconscious, and lets him rest on her shoulder.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Michaela… , what about Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: It's because I'm relaxed. Mika will help you a little.
(The white angel wings behind Michaela's back wrap around %s's body.)

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Huh, Michaela. So that I can cover those wings too... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Aurum. fizzle.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Wow, yes. I, Aurum, will protect my duties as a paladin. Boo… .

steps.name: unfinished business
steps.objective: Go to [Dana] in “Guild Alliance City Center Esnil”.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: Are you out of your mind?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, here… . right. I was back.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what about this? white wings... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaaa!!

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Don’t be surprised when you see Mika.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um, Michaela?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika caught your spirits up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Michaela.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: By the way, did you come here with Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: As the demons and demons disappeared, Michaela woke up. So I was waiting here.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I'm glad you're okay. Have you met the goddess?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Gaia... .

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Aren’t you asking more? Your Majesty will know anyway, even if Argent doesn’t hear it.)

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Thank you, Goddess, for saving me.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika was weak. That's why I couldn't save the goddess properly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. Mika, no, Mikaela is strong.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Gaia told me. %s, I am glad to have you as an oracle.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: %s received it. If the goddess said so, then it is truly a blessing.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Mika, I'll go inside the red door.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Hi Michaela. Barbatos has withdrawn, is there any reason to re-enter?

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: That relief is also part of the sanctuary. You have to recognize why that place was discovered. Otherwise, Mika will misunderstand again.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: If that’s what you mean, Michaela… .

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Because a being like Babotos must not touch the sanctuary or the goddesses again.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: %s. If you have any questions later, come see me. I'll be waiting for you inside the red door.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. Hi Michaela.

lines.speaker: 미카엘라
lines.text: Aurum and Argent… . thank you. I hope to meet Mika again someday. And %s… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I think Michaela has something she wants to say...)

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: See you later, Michaela.
(After saying hello, Michaela flaps her wings vigorously and heads toward the red door.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (…Now that I think about it, what does that smell mean?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I guess everything here is over. We don't know when Barbatos will appear again, but... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm anxious... Why is it getting closer and closer and never ending?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Phew… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It looks like everything here is done. What are you going to do with Argent and Aurum?

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: I think I need to sort things out.

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: I plan to return after visiting the elders of the sanctuary. I don't know when the elders will come... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Thank you all. I'm going back... . Ah, Argent. I'm going to see Dana. Do you have something to say?

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: All you have to do is tell the princess, ‘I’ve been waiting.’ All I have to say is that… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I understand. Then goodbye.

lines.speaker: 아우룸
lines.text: See you later. Adventurer, I hope we get to run wild together!

lines.speaker: 아르젠트
lines.text: See you later.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Welcome, Mr. %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, nothing bad happened, right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Thank you. Thanks to that, nothing much happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank goodness… .

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Seeing as %s has arrived, the oracle's work in the sanctuary is finished, right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes… . It didn't go according to Barbatos' plan. that is… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell Dana briefly about what happened at the sanctuary.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … That's it. Sorry. I should have taken the burden off %s... . I promise. At least next time something like this won't happen.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I was just doing my job.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: (It’s surprising that Argent is there….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Dana, Argent knows you, so I told him to do it if he had anything to say, and he left this message.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I waited. He said that Dana would know if I said that.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Did Argent say that?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. that's right.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I see. The driver, who was a boy, must still be concerned about what happened back then even as a young man.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm… ?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's about the Sylvaria Empire. I don't know where this will lead, but I don't want %s to know.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: … You're too good of a person for that... . So sorry.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. Dana, then I will go. I'll come back later. So don't be too sorry.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yeah... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Then let’s go to the minuet.)
(In the center of Adrika, a girl with blue hair is wandering around as if waiting for someone. Then, she spots someone approaching and stops.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer, welcome.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Minuet, are you okay?

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As you can see, I'm fine. Medea helped me.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Since it’s okay with Gaia, I can do this too… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Thank you for saving Gaia... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? I just did my job... .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: As Gaia said, you can now meet Iris. He will call you when the time comes.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer… .

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Iris Please cherish my thoughts for you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Huh, why do I feel like I can hear Gaia’s voice? Am I mistaken because Gaia’s incarnation is a minuet?)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, minuet… . For a moment, another thought occurred to me. sorry. Anyway, as Minuet said, I'm here for Iris.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes, Adventurer. Then I think I should sleep now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, minuet.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Should we meet Mediah later….)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Medea, are you okay?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes? ah… . yes. Then I will go.

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: Yes.
(As the crowd disappears from Adrica, Minuet quietly leans down next to a large rock. Then, she closes her eyes and goes to sleep, as if she wants to dream.)
(But only for a moment, and then he opens his eyes again.)

lines.speaker: 미뉴에트
lines.text: How many more days are left before I can sleep? ?
